Prior to coming to work at UTM, Dianne worked at Capilano University where she collaborated with faculty members to develop tools and processes to facilitate the assessment of student learning outcomes.* These will include: active learning strategies to enhance student learning and skill development, approaches to prepare students for class, methods for assessment and teaching technologies.
